# Humble Beeing

> Humble Beeing is a Kampala-based Ugandan producer of pure raw honey, infused honeys, hand-poured beeswax candles, and luxury gift hampers, made with smallholder farmers through traceable, regenerative beekeeping. Every batch is independently lab-tested for purity. Member of TUNADO (The Uganda National Apiculture Development Organisation); certified by the Uganda National Bureau of Standards (UNBS).

## Products

Full range with prices, tasting notes, pairings, and FAQs: https://humble-beeing.com/products

Raw single-origin honey (350g, UGX 30,000 — harvested and bottled by region, never blended):
- [Yumbe Shea Blossom Honey](https://humble-beeing.com/products/yumbe-shea-blossom-honey) — best seller; buttery caramel monofloral honey from the West Nile shea belt
- [Nebbi Multifloral Honey](https://humble-beeing.com/products/nebbi-multifloral-honey) — dark, complex wild-forage honey
- [Arua Calliandra Blossom Honey](https://humble-beeing.com/products/arua-calliandra-honey) — light, delicate floral honey

Infused raw honey (350g, UGX 35,000 — whole real ingredients aged in raw honey, no heat, no fermentation):
- [Vanilla Bean](https://humble-beeing.com/products/vanilla-bean-infused-honey) — best seller; aged with whole locally sourced Ugandan vanilla pods
- [Rosemary](https://humble-beeing.com/products/rosemary-infused-honey) — best seller; savoury-sweet, the cook's favourite
- [Lemon Peel](https://humble-beeing.com/products/lemon-peel-infused-honey) — sun-dried lemon zest, classic sore-throat remedy
- [Orange Peel](https://humble-beeing.com/products/orange-peel-infused-honey) — marmalade notes, baker's and bartender's jar
- [Scotch Bonnet Chilli](https://humble-beeing.com/products/scotch-bonnet-chilli-infused-honey) — Uganda's hot honey, for pizza and fried chicken
- [Garlic](https://humble-beeing.com/products/garlic-infused-honey) — allicin-rich kitchen remedy for cold season

Candles, cosmetics and gifts:
- [Natural Beeswax Candle — Lemongrass & Ginger](https://humble-beeing.com/products/beeswax-candle) (200g, ~60h burn, UGX 70,000), hand-poured in Kampala
- [Natural Beeswax Lip Balm](https://humble-beeing.com/products/beeswax-lip-balm) (15g, UGX 12,000)
- [Honey Taster Gift Set](https://humble-beeing.com/products/taster-gift-set) (4 × 30g, UGX 40,000) — weddings, kwanjula/kukyala introduction ceremonies, corporate gifting
- Wholesale and bulk honey for chefs, hotels, retailers, and NGOs

## Where to buy

- Online shop with Kampala delivery: https://shop.humble-beeing.com
- Stocked at select hotels, delis, and cafés across Kampala
